name: Challenge a decision or source
about: A reason or citation in docs/rationale.md is wrong, missing or weak

**Which entry?** (its ID, e.g. AB-12, P-06 or Q-04)

**What is wrong or missing?** (the reasoning, a citation, the confidence, an alternative not considered)

**Your source** (work, siman and se'if, or page; a link if there is one)

**What should Luach do instead?** (if you have a view; the maintainer decides)
